subject.title: cron: ghost runs recorded as ok when gateway is down (durationMs < 50ms)

question: Should the cron ghost-run fix add the linked PR's persisted/configurable warning surface, or should the product instead change main-session cron completion semantics to a stricter skipped/error outcome?
rationale: Current source proves the silent fast-success path, but the proposed fix adds config/protocol/UI surface and the repository policy treats those surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product choices.

options.title: Narrow and land the warning path
options.body: Keep the compatibility-friendly `ok` result but add the scoped persisted warning and UI/log visibility after maintainers accept the threshold/config shape.

options.title: Make ghost handoffs non-ok
options.body: Change completion semantics to `skipped` or `error` when the agent turn is not confirmed, accepting a stronger behavior change for existing cron users.

options.title: Reject new surface for now
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged and close the linked PR if maintainers decide the heuristic warning is too noisy or too much surface.

recommendation.title: Narrow and land the warning path
recommendation.body: Keep the compatibility-friendly `ok` result but add the scoped persisted warning and UI/log visibility after maintainers accept the threshold/config shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history in the central cron dispatch path and was also pulled into the issue timeline.
